output.summary: Helpdesk tickets in Abuja rose 101.9% mainly because increased late deliveries in Abuja during September 2026 generated more delivery_delay tickets. helpdesk tickets (Abuja) went 54 tickets → 109 tickets (+101.9%) from August 2026 to September 2026. [H2] Deliveries got much worse: late-delivery rate 5.9%→19.0%, avg delay up to 14.5h; carrier changed from Kòlá Fleet to SwiftRoute 3PL. Delivery-delay tickets carry 71% of the rise. Ruled out: abuja stockout days for key SKUs rose in September 2026, driving out_of_stock tickets [H1]; price increases for Abuja SKUs effective September 2026 triggered price_complaint tickets [H3]; normal seasonal pattern in Abuja causes higher helpdesk volume each September versus August [H4].

brief.headline: Helpdesk tickets in Abuja rose 101.9% mainly because increased late deliveries in Abuja during September 2026 generated more delivery_delay tickets.
brief.summary: helpdesk tickets (Abuja) went 54 tickets → 109 tickets (+101.9%) from August 2026 to September 2026. [H2] Deliveries got much worse: late-delivery rate 5.9%→19.0%, avg delay up to 14.5h; carrier changed from Kòlá Fleet to SwiftRoute 3PL. Delivery-delay tickets carry 71% of the rise. Ruled out: abuja stockout days for key SKUs rose in September 2026, driving out_of_stock tickets [H1]; price increases for Abuja SKUs effective September 2026 triggered price_complaint tickets [H3]; normal seasonal pattern in Abuja causes higher helpdesk volume each September versus August [H4].

causes.statement: Increased late deliveries in Abuja during September 2026 generated more delivery_delay tickets.
causes.finding: Deliveries got much worse: late-delivery rate 5.9%→19.0%, avg delay up to 14.5h; carrier changed from Kòlá Fleet to SwiftRoute 3PL. Delivery-delay tickets carry 71% of the rise.

evidence.sql: SELECT month, carrier, SUM(deliveries_scheduled) AS scheduled, SUM(deliveries_late) AS late, AVG(avg_delay_hours) AS delay_hours FROM kola.logistics WHERE city = 'Abuja' AND month IN ('2026-08', '2026-09') GROUP BY month, carrier ORDER BY month

causes.statement: Most of the change sits in delivery delay and out of stock tickets
causes.finding: The change is concentrated in: delivery_delay 39 tickets (71% of the net change); out_of_stock 20 tickets (36% of the net change). Partly offset by billing -1 tickets, product_quality -3 tickets.

evidence.sql: SELECT category, SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN tickets ELSE 0 END) AS target, SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN tickets ELSE 0 END) AS baseline FROM kola.helpdesk WHERE month IN ('2026-08', '2026-09') AND city = 'Abuja' GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

ruled_out.statement: Abuja stockout days for key SKUs rose in September 2026, driving out_of_stock tickets.
ruled_out.finding: No meaningful stockouts in Abuja: no SKU was out of stock 5+ days in 2026-09.

evidence.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-09' THEN stockout_days ELSE 0 END) AS target, SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN stockout_days ELSE 0 END) AS baseline FROM kola.warehouse_inventory WHERE city = 'Abuja' AND month IN ('2026-08', '2026-09') GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku

ruled_out.statement: Price increases for Abuja SKUs effective September 2026 triggered price_complaint tickets.
ruled_out.finding: Only one Abuja SKU (KOKO-500) had a price increase in September 2026: +2.8% (₦1,800→₦1,850) effective 2026-09-01. However, price_complaint tickets remained flat at 6 (baseline 6 → target 6), contributing 0% of the +55 ticket increase. The surge came from delivery_delay (+39) and out_of_stock (+20).

evidence.sql: SELECT effective_date, sku, city, old_price_ngn, new_price_ngn, reason FROM kola.price_book WHERE effective_date > '2026-08-01' AND effective_date <= '2026-09-31' AND city IN ('Abuja', 'ALL') ORDER BY effective_date

ruled_out.statement: Normal seasonal pattern in Abuja causes higher helpdesk volume each September versus August.
ruled_out.finding: A year earlier the same months moved -5.6%, against +101.9% now: this is not the normal seasonal pattern.

evidence.sql: SELECT month, SUM(tickets) AS value FROM kola.helpdesk WHERE month IN ('2025-08', '2025-09') AND city = 'Abuja' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

caveats: Kòlá Foods is a fictional company; its systems hold synthetic demo data.

recommendations: Hold the logistics partner in Abuja to an on-time SLA and track late deliveries weekly; consider reverting if it does not recover within a month.
